text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, excuse me... Good day, Trainer.
choice_data_list: You look sleepy, what's the matter?
You look sleepy, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I ended up spending quite a bit of time 
researching. That is the price paid for 
obtaining knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Still, being seen caught off guard like 
that might be considered too high a price 
to pay.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Let's just say—you didn't see anything, if 
you would be so kind, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While giving off a bizarre, intimidating 
aura, Dream Journey clearly looked 
sleep-deprived.
